response.overview: In this CGI video, Fang Yang disorients and recombines superheroes, bodily organs, and everyday spaces. The camera travels through blood vessels, emerges from the swirling vortex of a toilet, and drifts blindly between flesh, rooms, and gardens. Organs detach from the torso and writhe on their own, while excrement glows with a piercing fluorescence. The video is projected onto a suspended structure made of blocks of clay and exposed steel reinforcement. The gaps between the blocks fracture the projected image, while the bare steel bars reveal themselves as the skeletal framework supporting it. The camera searches for something to which it might attach; through projection, the image comes to inhabit the rough surface of the clay, briefly taking form across its unevenness, fractures, and gaps.
response.title: Until Dawn, Dusk Envelops the Suite
